items.title: 许可证变更预告：自 v1.8.1 起改为 AGPL-3.0（此前为 MIT）
items.body: 为保护本项目的真机调试成果（协议逆向、指纹对齐、签到链路等）不被闭源拿走，自 v1.8.1 起本仓库改用 AGPL-3.0。v1.8.0 及更早的已发布版本维持 MIT 不变。日常使用、自部署完全不受影响；AGPL 仅要求任何二次利用（含以网络服务形式提供）同样开源。
items.titleEn: License change notice: AGPL-3.0 starting with v1.8.1 (previously MIT)
items.bodyEn: To protect this project's reverse-engineering work (protocol reverse-ing, fingerprint alignment, check-in chains) from being taken closed-source, the repository adopts AGPL-3.0 starting with v1.8.1. Released versions up to v1.8.0 remain MIT. Everyday use and self-hosting are unaffected; AGPL only requires any reuse — including offering it as a network service — to be released under the same license.

items.title: Qoder 排队机制与账号风控说明
items.body: 部分 Qoder 账号请求出现持续排队（底层返回 10605）。官方证实此为调用触发的账号级风控惩罚（慢速队列）。订阅套餐享有专属优先通道；遇到排队时，10Router 会自动识别并冷却顺延至其他可用账号。
items.titleEn: Qoder queue throttle and account rate-limit explained
items.bodyEn: Some Qoder accounts have experienced continuous queue waiting ('Estimated wait time ~1 min', upstream code 10605). According to official responses, this is a targeted rate-limit applied to accounts with high-frequency access patterns. Subscribed accounts enjoy prioritized lanes; 10Router automatically detects code 10605 and fails over to other accounts.

items.title: Loomy 模型池收紧：三款下线，新增 MiMo V2.5
items.body: 讯飞收紧模型池：Qwen 3.8 Max / MiniMax M3 / Kimi K2.6 下线不可调（组合引用了它们的请更新成员）；新增 MiMo V2.5（全模态，×3.3）。各模型积分倍率已标注在模型行（Spark-X2.6 正式版限时免费 ×0.0）。多账号的邀请码可在 CreditDaddy 快速填写与获取。
items.titleEn: Loomy model pool tightened: 3 models retired, MiMo V2.5 added
items.bodyEn: iFlytek tightened the pool: Qwen 3.8 Max / MiniMax M3 / Kimi K2.6 are retired (update combos referencing them); MiMo V2.5 added (omni-modal, x3.3). Credit multipliers are now labeled on model rows (Spark-X2.6 official is free for a limited time, x0.0). Invite codes for multiple accounts can be quickly filled/obtained via CreditDaddy.

items.title: DeepAI Code 供应商：27 模型免费档，面板内直接登录
items.body: 免费额度区新增 DeepAI Code（deepai.org 桌面编程 agent）：11 个免费不计量模型 + 16 个按次花每日 Theos（GPT-6.1 Sol / Gemini 4 Hydrogen / Claude Fable 5.2 等都有）。添加连接在面板内完成 Google/Apple 浏览器登录——回调地址粘回即建连，本机不装任何东西；已有 API Key 也可直接粘贴。模型行亮「免费」/「配额 N」徽章，Theos 余额自动进配额页。
items.titleEn: DeepAI Code provider: 27 models free-tier, panel-native sign-in
items.bodyEn: DeepAI Code (deepai.org desktop coding agent) joins the free-tier section: 11 unmetered free models plus 16 metered against the daily Theos grant (GPT-6.1 Sol / Gemini 4 Hydrogen / Claude Fable 5.2 included). Adding a connection runs the Google/Apple browser sign-in inside the panel — paste the callback URL back and the connection is created, nothing to install. Existing API keys can be pasted directly. Model rows carry Free / Quota N badges; the Theos balance lands in the quota page automatically.

items.title: WPS 灵犀供应商：粘贴 Cookie 即用，原生签到与到期桶
items.body: 全新供应商「灵犀」（WPS）：供应商页 Capture Session 三步引导（书签签 / 直接粘贴）或从 CreditDaddy 一键同步。配额卡按智点口径呈现——余额 + 逐包到期桶 + 最早到期倒计时；实验性页开关打开后自动领每日灵点（100/天、第七天 200），配额卡头显示「今日已签到 · 连续 N 天」。免费档日常对话不扣灵点。
items.titleEn: WPS Lingxi provider: paste a cookie to start, native check-in and expiry buckets
items.bodyEn: A new provider line, Lingxi (WPS): the provider page walks you through Capture Session (bookmarklet or direct paste), or sync from CreditDaddy. The quota card speaks the credit language — balance + per-batch expiry buckets + earliest-expiry countdown. Flip the Experimental toggle for native daily check-in (100/day, 200 on day seven) with a streak badge on the quota card. Free-tier chat costs no credits.

items.title: Meoo 秒悟供应商：OAuth 登录 / 控制面 Key 双通道
items.body: 全新供应商「秒悟」：OAuth（CLI 同款 PKCE）或粘贴控制面 Key 双通道接入；项目服务 AK 自动解析、失效自愈。积分账户完整呈现——余额 + 批次有效期（订阅 / 登录赠送 / 邀请奖励逐包到期）；实验性页新增「每日自动领积分」开关；模型行带价格倾向徽章（便宜 / 适中 / 较贵 / 超贵，官网同款）。
items.titleEn: Meoo provider: OAuth or control-plane key, full points ledger
items.bodyEn: A new provider, Meoo: connect via OAuth (CLI-style PKCE) or pasting a control-plane key; the per-project service AK resolves itself and self-heals. The points ledger shows balance + per-batch expiry (subscription / daily-login / invite grants each carry their own dates). The Experimental page adds an auto daily-claim toggle; model rows carry price-tendency badges matching the official picker.

items.title: DuMate 百度搭子供应商：扫码登录，全程不拉起浏览器
items.body: 全新供应商「DuMate」（百度）：扫码登录全链路面板内完成（getqrcode → 长轮询 → 快捷登录，内置 SSRF 白名单）。配额卡按积分池语言呈现——订阅窗折叠进余额大数右侧、加油包逐包明细；额度包隐藏偏好改用稳定组合键，包过期重排后不再错位。
items.titleEn: DuMate (Baidu) provider: QR-code login without spawning a browser
items.bodyEn: A new provider, DuMate (Baidu): QR-code login runs entirely in the panel (getqrcode → long-poll → quick login, with an SSRF allowlist). The quota card speaks the credit-pool language — the subscription window folds beside the balance headline and top-up packs are itemised; pack hide-preferences use a stable composite key so expiring packs no longer shuffle.

items.title: Gemini Decision 1 供应商：System One 决策 lane 补齐多模态
items.body: System One 决策模型新增 Gemini Decision 1（Google DeepMind）：typed questions 进、校准概率出，与 Drex 协议同构但支持文本/图片/音频/视频/PDF 五模态（Drex 只有文本/图片）。API Key 从 Google AI Studio 创建，免费层 200 请求/分钟。决策 lane 可按模态路由：文本/图片走 Drex，音/视频/PDF 走 Gemini。
items.titleEn: Gemini Decision 1 provider: multimodal decision lane alongside Drex
items.bodyEn: The System One decision lane gains Gemini Decision 1 (Google DeepMind): typed questions in, calibrated probabilities out — protocol-aligned with Drex but natively multimodal (text/image/audio/video/PDF vs Drex's text/image). API keys come from Google AI Studio; free tier is 200 requests/min. Route by modality: text/images via Drex, audio/video/PDF via Gemini.
